title: Cosmic Crystal Oracle
description: A small astronaut in an orange suit stands on a glowing orange platform inside a large transparent crystal ball. Inside the orb, a luminous green female face with closed eyes is surrounded by swirling neon purple, pink, and blue energy tendrils and sparkles. The crystal ball rests on a metallic base in a mystical room with swirling green and purple smoke in the background.
